No rear access — everything carried through the house
Heavy clay — hard digging and heavy to cart
Tree roots through the dig area
Winter working — short days and wet ground
Long carry from parking to the work area

No machine access — everything by hand
Terracing — levels rarely work out as drawn
Retaining over 600 mm — drainage and engineering requirements

validation.message: Buried services aren't located and you're digging. Get a CAT scan or a utility search before you price this.
Nothing measured yet — add an area or a run length.
Front driveway over 5 m² with non-permeable jointing. That needs permeable build-up or planning permission — record the decision before you quote.
Over 8 m³ to dig by hand. Check whether a machine can get in — it changes the price by multiples, not percentages.
Turf with no ground preparation. It will fail, and you'll be back.
Retaining over 600 mm needs drainage behind it and, above about 1 m, an engineer's note. Don't absorb that risk silently.
More muck than a 12-yard skip holds. Price multiple skips or a grab lorry.
Hire spans a weekend. You're charged calendar days — check the extra days are in the price.
This job hit the difficulty cap. Walk it again before you commit to a number.
You're charging less per hour than the work costs you.

exclusions: Diversion, repair or protection of buried services
Removal of contaminated ground or unforeseen buried obstructions
Structural retaining above 600 mm without a separate engineering design
Tree works requiring a licence or affecting a protected tree (TPO)
Reinstatement of concealed drainage, cabling or irrigation damaged during excavation
Ongoing maintenance, watering or aftercare of turf and planting
assumptions: Access to the work area as described and agreed at the time of quoting
Water and power available on site unless a generator is priced above
Spoil is inert and free of contamination
The site is clear of vehicles, pets and stored items on arrival
Levels are as found on the day of the visit
presentation.programmeCaveat: Programme is in working days and excludes weather delays.
